name: Consumer Protection Commission
primary_cta: File a complaint: four task answers in the hero open the complaint desk, which sends a written-out complaint by WhatsApp (242) 357-7898 or email complaints@bahamas.gov.bs; call (242) 604-9020
brand_truth: The public referee when a business will not put things right: it logs, reviews, contacts the business and keeps you updated.
buyer: Commission leadership; audience is Bahamian consumers, often upset, many on older phones.

direction.type: T08 Warm humanist (Young Serif + Nunito Sans)
direction.why: Task-first gov.uk clarity for upset visitors, warmed by a humanist serif on limestone; sea glass accent from the national aquamarine, deepened for AA. A12+P02 and A12+P10 were taken by competitors.

concept_type: service desk: task-first hero with live promise rail, what happens next, before you file, complaint builder (WhatsApp/email), URCA routing, visit
